page.overview:
Who is Eddie?

Eddie was a member of the Dig in the badlands of Montana.

The boy was among the many people who saw the x-ray of a recently excavated Velociraptor in June of 1993.

He derided the appearance of Velociraptor, calling it nothing more than a six-foot turkey and implying it wouldn't have been very scary. Dr. Alan Grant then scared the boy, suggesting a scenario in which he met a raptor in real life. Doctor Grant suggested that the raptor would distract him while other raptors would attack from the sides, then rip him apart using the retractable claw on their foot, spill his intestines, and be left alive when it begins to eat him. The child looks on in stunned silence.

While going to the trailer of the dig site, Ellie admonishes Alan that that was an overly graphic lesson for such a young child. Alan says Eddie's attitude was a main reason why he hates children. Grant's disdain for children would ultimately be undone after rescuing Tim and Lex Murphy, whose attitudes were much different than Eddie's.
